name: BC/MBC Free Education Scheme (UG Degree)
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
description: Free education scheme for BC, BCM, MBC, and DNC students pursuing 3-year UG degree courses in Government and Government-Aided colleges.
benefit: Complete tuition fee waiver credited annually.

name: BC/MBC Post-Matric Scholarship
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
description: Financial assistance for BC, BCM, MBC, and DNC students pursuing post-matric polytechnic, professional, and higher education courses.
benefit: Yearly scholarship amount credited directly to bank account.

name: SC Post-Matric Scholarship
department: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Department
description: Financial assistance for SC and SCA students pursuing higher education.
benefit: Yearly scholarship covering tuition fee and maintenance allowance.

name: ST Post-Matric Scholarship
description: Financial assistance for ST students pursuing higher education.
benefit: Yearly scholarship covering tuition fee and maintenance allowance.

name: First Graduate Tuition Fee Concession
description: Fee concession for students who are the first in their family to graduate, admitted under single window counselling.
benefit: Tuition fee waiver for professional and UG degree courses.

name: Differently Abled Students Scholarship
department: Welfare of Differently Abled Persons Department
description: Scholarship for students with disabilities (40% and above) to support higher education.
benefit: Annual financial stipend and book allowance.

name: Minority Students Scholarship
department: Backward Classes, Most Backward Classes and Minorities Welfare Department
description: Scholarship targeted at religious minority students (Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, Parsi) for post-matric studies.

name: Tamil Nadu Merit Scholarship
description: Merit award for students scoring 75% or higher in qualifying examinations.

name: Pudhumai Penn Scheme
department: Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department
description: Higher education assurance assistance for female students who studied classes VI to XII in Tamil Nadu Government schools.
benefit: Rs. 1,000 per month credited directly to bank account until degree completion.

name: Tamil Pudhalvan Scheme
description: Higher education assistance for male students who studied classes VI to XII in Tamil Nadu Government schools.
benefit: Rs. 1,000 per month credited directly to bank account until degree completion.
